hooks.name: Check Drawio Layout
hooks.description: After creating or editing a .drawio file, remind the agent to call drawio_auto_layout to verify no overlapping nodes or edge crossings, then export PNG

action.prompt: You just created/modified a .drawio file. MANDATORY: Call drawio_auto_layout(file_path="{filePath}") to check for overlapping nodes and edge crossings. If issues found, fix them using waypoints on edges (not by restructuring layout). Then export to PNG using export_drawio tool with absolute path.
